{{Quote|Looks like we're late again.|Djas Puhr, after losing a bounty|<ref name="Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine">''[[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]''</ref>}}
'''Djas Puhr''' was a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], who had excellent infrared and peripheral vision, as well as a highly developed sense of smell and hearing. His black robes and ebony skin allowed him to disappear into the night; his powerful eyes allowed him to see prey as they slept, even through walls; and his keen sense of smell allowed him to hunt any creature that tried to flee. Puhr often partnered with an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] hunter named [[Gondry]].<ref name="Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]''</ref>  He was a tracker for [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] and an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] in a slave network employed by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. In that standard year, Puhr abducted several [[Ghostling]] children from the planet [[Datar/Legends|Datar]] for Sebulba. He then tracked a young [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his childhood friends, who had reclaimed the several Ghostling children from the clutches of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]]. Although he failed to capture the young Skywalker, his childhood friends, and the Ghosting children.

Djas remained an active bounty hunter for decades. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he had developed a reputation as an imposing figure who followed through on his promises.<ref name="FF CAN6">{{FactFile|22|CAN 1-6|Mos Eisley Cantina Characters}}</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] Djas Puhr was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] sitting at a table with [[Muftak/Legends|Muftak]], [[Myo/Legends|Myo]] and [[Lirin Car'n/Legends|Lirin Car'n]]. During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Djas Puhr was still active as a bounty hunter and was regularly hired by Jabba.
